fact: Law No 058/2021 of 13/10/2021, published in the Official Gazette on 15 October 2021, gives data subjects the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing and designates the public authority in charge of cyber security as supervisory authority.
title: Law relating to the Protection of Personal Data and Privacy
publisher: Official Gazette of the Republic of Rwanda (via RwandaLII)
